turns.text: Good to see you again. Where would you like to start today?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today.
Take your time.
I have been eating only about a thousand calories a day for the last year and I count everything.
What happened next?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment. It is not easy to talk about.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I am a second-year law student at Edinburgh and the exams are what stress me most.
What went through your mind then?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
What went through your mind then?
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television.
Tell me more about that.
My flatmate Aisha said she is worried because I skip dinner with everyone.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy. That is how it was.
What went through your mind then?
If I do not get a first-class mark on an essay I feel completely worthless.
What went through your mind then?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. I think so, yes.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
Let us stop here for today.
Thank you, see you next week.
